Demand title: Employee self-service mobile app for leave and attendance
Business need / problem: Employees request leave and check attendance by email and a paper form. Managers approve by email and HR re-types everything into the HR system. Approvals take 3 to 5 days and errors are common.
Expected outcome / benefit: Leave and attendance requests handled in under 1 day with no re-typing
Reason for urgency / deadline: Peak leave season starts June 2027; internal audit finding on manual records

Business need / problem: A new mandatory digital financial reporting format starts next year. We export from the finance system into spreadsheets and rebuild the report by hand every quarter. It takes 6 working days and 3 people.
Expected outcome / benefit: Report produced in the mandated format in 1 day with a full audit trail
Reason for urgency / deadline: Mandated format takes effect on 1 Jan 2027

Business need / problem: Complaints arrive by phone, email and the website and are tracked in different spreadsheets. We cannot see the status of a complaint or who is handling it, and we miss the 10-day response target for about 1 in 5 complaints.
Expected outcome / benefit: One view of every complaint with owner, status and response-time alerts
Reason for urgency / deadline: Response-target breaches are reported to the Executive Committee every month
Systems or data mentioned: Contact centre platform, website forms, email
